_why: Which AgentX WebMate extension release the desktop installer bundles (apps/desktop/scripts/fetch-webmate.mjs downloads it into apps/desktop/build/webmate/ before `npm run build`). `version` names the GitHub Release tag (v<version>) of astralxkienlt/agentx-webmate; `sha256` is the Chrome zip's digest and must match both the download and that release's signed release.json. `sha256: null` means the release does not exist yet — the fetch step then ships nothing and the app fetches the signed feed on first launch; a local build can be bundled with `node scripts/fetch-webmate.mjs --from-dir <webmate>/dist`. Pin a published release with `node scripts/fetch-webmate.mjs --pin <version>`.
